entries.title: HONOR official OTA
entries.compatibility: Exact model and region are checked by the phone itself
entries.details: The supported path to update MagicOS. The phone verifies the signed package before installing it. This does not replace MagicOS with a custom ROM.

entries.title: Android Dynamic System Updates (DSU)
entries.compatibility: Only if HONOR exposes DSU Loader and accepts a compatible trusted image
entries.details: DSU can boot a guest Android system image while keeping the original system available. Device-manufacturer support is required. This is not a confirmed X8b feature.

entries.title: Google Generic System Images (GSI)
entries.compatibility: Not confirmed for HONOR X8b; standard GSI requirements include Treble compliance and an unlocked bootloader
entries.details: A GSI is a clean Android system baseline, not a fully device-customized ROM. Hardware functions can be missing. Do not install unless the exact device configuration is verified.

notice: No custom ROM is currently verified as installable on the user's specific HONOR X8b variant. Do not cross-flash images for another model, region, or board.
